item_name: Rothco Army Vietnam Vet Deluxe Low Pro Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Army Vietnam Veteran Low Profile Cap is a tribute to those who served with honor. The front panel features a raised embroidered Army insignia, while the brim is adorned with "Vietnam Vet" printed in bold lettering. Inside, the Vietnam Vet embroidery seam tape adds a unique touch of detail. Constructed from 100% brushed cotton twill, this military cap offers a comfortable and durable fit. The cap’s low profile design provides a sleek, modern look, and the hook & loop closure ensures an adjustable fit.
